what_this_is: THE single panel-max direct null every Round-20 Phase-S lane adjudicates against. Resolves I3's G-PANEL failure by adopting a directly-fitted panel-max curve (R1 B-i/B-ii) instead of a per-register bar with a disputed effective-test count.
claim_statistic: pmax  (I2 max-over-9-registers, z scale; NEVER en, NEVER -5.5)
why_not_keff: I3 G-PANEL FAILED: the two per-register M_eff estimators disagree 2.06-2.45x (I3 S6.2); the panel penalty is not a constant of the panel (it shrinks with N: 2.27 z-units at N=1, 1.02 at N=1e6, 0.39 at N=1e9). A directly-fitted panel-max null needs no multiplicity model at all.
how_to_call: from panelmax20 import panelmax_bar; panelmax_bar(preset='exact', n_round_adjudicated=N, alpha=0.01)

exact.adjudicator_register: I2 9-register panel {EN_MODERN,EN_KJV,LP1_REAL,LATIN,OE,DE,CY,EN_HALFVOWEL,EN_NOVOWEL}; pmax = max z. EN_NOVOWEL recovery 67-81% => a hit there is DETECTION, not readable plaintext (I2).
exact.null_generator: uniform-random rune ciphertext x uniform-random keystream, wrong-key beam decode (decoder-output null, NOT random runes); validated vs LP2 histogram-shuffle in I3 S1.2
